ops.title: cc-present D8: how earlier rounds' history loads, and whether iOS moves too (Oct 27 2026)
ops.body: Owner picked: (1) Stubs + one fetch: the snapshot carries a stub per closed round (number, title, submittedRevision, block ids, plus the feedback, replies and labels the rail needs); opening the Earlier rounds drawer fetches every round's frozen blocks in one GET /api/rounds?session=. (2) Move iOS too: the iOS app loads from the same snapshot endpoint instead of replaying the full log.
